name: signal_query
description: Query monitor time-series observations (macro FRED/EIA/Treasury, market quotes, sentiment). Series are self-describing with units, e.g. fred:VIXCLS, fred:CPIAUCSL_YOY, quote:AAPL, sentiment:AAPL, eia:WTI_SPOT_USD_BBL.

from.description: ISO8601 lower bound (optional, default: no bound)

series.description: Series name or LIKE pattern, e.g. "fred:%", "quote:AAPL", "sentiment:%"
